description: This file defines the OrganizationsClient class for interacting with AWS Organizations service, including method signatures for various AWS SDK operations and their async variants.

classes.name: OrganizationsClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS Organizations API, extending Aws\AwsClient, providing methods for organization management operations.

methods.name: acceptHandshake
methods.description: Accepts a handshake request for an AWS Organization.

methods.name: attachPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a policy to an AWS Organization entity.

methods.name: closeAccount
methods.description: Closes an AWS account within the organization.
